segments.title: Google Meet pops out when you leave its tab
segments.body: Join the call, then switch to another tab. 0.2.47-nightly.2 asked the call to pop out while its page was still visible, so a page that waits until it's hidden, as Meet does, stayed put and the call ran on out of sight. Now it's asked once hidden: the call pops into Picture in Picture, and coming back closes it.
segments.note: a local call page that behaves like Meet
